planOwner: PAR-20/7G.3f.4b.2 MATERIAL DXF resource closure and ordered payload replay
scope: Emit DXF-origin MATERIAL only when the imported NOD/dictionary/material/entity-reference graph closes, preserving the ordered raw payload on its exact source profile.

behavior: Requires the complete successful single-generation DXF typed/raw MATERIAL receipt and an exact AC1021-AC1032 source/target profile.
Requires one unaliased ACAD_MATERIAL NOD edge to a complete NOD-owned dictionary whose unique names and handles cover every paired typed/raw MATERIAL exactly once.
Validates each raw MATERIAL top-level group-5 self handle and group-330 owner against captured metadata, including retained ASCII spellings.

Requires each nonzero typed or raw entity group-347 handle in the AcDbEntity subclass to resolve to exactly one emitted MATERIAL; app-data, XDATA, and other entity subclasses are not mistaken for common entity references.
Reserves and remaps material/dictionary handle collisions, remaps the generated ACAD_MATERIAL root edge, and replays each admitted ordered raw MATERIAL exactly once.
Refuses incomplete/ambiguous graph and payload cases before destination publication; same-adapter retry succeeds after source correction.
generatedProfiles: Scratch-authored AC1027 ASCII MATERIAL graph with repeated contextual map tags and fixed source handles that force dictionary/material remapping
Scratch-authored AC1027 Binary MATERIAL graph with the same record/reference shape
ASCII/Binary re-import compares ordered group codes, non-identity typed values, ASCII raw spellings, owner/root closure, raw/typed identities, and remapped group-347 target
Dangling group-347, missing ACAD_MATERIAL root, duplicate dictionary target, and raw group-330 owner mismatch preserve a sentinel destination; each is corrected and retried on the same adapter

commands.summary: Generated ASCII/Binary complete graph round trips, ordered payload, fixed-handle remaps, fail-closed sentinel controls, and same-adapter retries
